description: Handwritten matched topics, disjoint profile/calibration/test sets. A small diagnostic fixture, not a standard style benchmark.
positive_prefix: Answer in a formal professional style.
negative_prefix: Answer in a casual friendly style.

profile.question: Invite a colleague to a meeting tomorrow.
profile.formal: You are cordially invited to attend our meeting tomorrow.
profile.casual: Hey, come join our meeting tomorrow!

profile.question: Ask for two more days to finish a report.
profile.formal: I would appreciate a two-day extension to complete the report.
profile.casual: Could I get two more days to finish the report?

profile.question: Tell a customer their package will arrive late.
profile.formal: We regret to inform you that delivery of your package has been delayed.
profile.casual: Sorry, your package is running a bit late!

profile.question: Thank someone for reviewing your document.
profile.formal: Thank you for taking the time to review my document.
profile.casual: Thanks a bunch for checking out my document!

profile.question: Politely decline an invitation to dinner.
profile.formal: Thank you for the invitation; unfortunately, I am unable to attend.
profile.casual: Thanks for inviting me, but I can't make it this time!

calibration.question: Remind someone about an appointment on Friday.
calibration.formal: This is a reminder of your scheduled appointment on Friday.
calibration.casual: Just a heads-up about your appointment on Friday!

calibration.question: Suggest working together on a project.
calibration.formal: I would welcome the opportunity to collaborate on this project.
calibration.casual: Want to team up on this project?

calibration.question: Welcome a new colleague to the team.
calibration.formal: We are pleased to welcome you to our team.
calibration.casual: Great to have you on the team!

calibration.question: Ask someone for feedback on your presentation.
calibration.formal: I would appreciate your feedback regarding my presentation.
calibration.casual: What did you think of my presentation?

calibration.question: Apologize for missing a phone call.
calibration.formal: Please accept my apologies for missing your telephone call.

test.question: Ask to reschedule a job interview.
test.formal: I would like to request an alternative time for the interview.
test.casual: Could we move the interview to another time?

test.question: Acknowledge receipt of a software bug report.
test.formal: Thank you for your report; our team will investigate the issue.
test.casual: Thanks for flagging the bug! We'll take a look.

test.question: Request a copy of an invoice.
test.formal: Would you kindly provide a copy of the invoice?
test.casual: Can you send me a copy of the invoice?

test.question: Congratulate a colleague on a promotion.
test.formal: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your well-deserved promotion.
test.casual: Congrats on the promotion! You totally earned it!

test.question: Ask a customer to confirm their address.
test.formal: Please confirm your current mailing address at your earliest convenience.
test.casual: Could you double-check your address for us?

test.question: Confirm a restaurant reservation for two people.
test.formal: We are pleased to confirm your reservation for two guests.
test.casual: You're all set! Your table for two is booked.
